examples.hanzi: 警察用车子掩护群众撤离。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá yòng chēzi yǎnhù qúnzhòng chèlí.
examples.english: The police used vehicles to shield the crowd as it evacuated.

examples.hanzi: 这些树木掩护了他们的行动。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùmù yǎnhù le tāmen de xíngdòng.
examples.english: The trees covered their movements.

examples.hanzi: 这面镜子有点脏，需要擦一擦。
examples.pinyin: Zhè miàn jìngzi yǒudiǎn zāng, xūyào cā yi cā.
examples.english: This mirror is a bit dirty and needs a wipe.

examples.hanzi: 小孩子对着镜子做鬼脸。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo háizi duì zhe jìngzi zuò guǐliǎn.
examples.english: The little kid is making faces at the mirror.

examples.pinyin: Tā hé tā de qíngrén zài hǎibiān sànbù.
examples.english: He and his lover are strolling by the sea.

examples.hanzi: 情人节那天，餐厅里坐满了情人。
examples.pinyin: Qíngrénjié nàtiān, cāntīng lǐ zuò mǎn le qíngrén.
examples.english: On Valentine's Day, the restaurant was full of lovers.

examples.hanzi: 这是一首经典的老歌。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yì shǒu jīngdiǎn de lǎo gē.
examples.english: This is a classic old song.

examples.hanzi: 他们每年都会重看这部经典的电影。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen měi nián dōu huì chóng kàn zhè bù jīngdiǎn de diànyǐng.
examples.english: They rewatch this classic movie every year.

examples.hanzi: 这座城市充满了活力。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò chéngshì chōngmǎn le huólì.
examples.english: This city is full of vitality.

examples.hanzi: 早上跑步让我一整天都有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang pǎobù ràng wǒ yì zhěng tiān dōu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Running in the morning gives me energy all day.

examples.hanzi: 这个图书馆星期天也开门。
examples.pinyin: Zhège túshūguǎn xīngqītiān yě kāimén.
examples.english: This library is open on Sundays too.

examples.hanzi: 我在图书馆借了三本书。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài túshūguǎn jiè le sān běn shū.
examples.english: I borrowed three books at the library.

examples.hanzi: 他看起来很累，显得比实际年龄老。
examples.pinyin: Tā kàn qǐlái hěn lèi, xiǎnde bǐ shíjì niánlíng lǎo.
examples.english: He looks tired and seems older than his real age.

examples.hanzi: 穿上这件衣服，你显得更高了。
examples.pinyin: Chuān shàng zhè jiàn yīfu, nǐ xiǎnde gèng gāo le.
examples.english: In this outfit, you look taller.

examples.hanzi: 法院判处这名罪犯死刑。
examples.pinyin: Fǎyuàn pànchǔ zhè míng zuìfàn sǐxíng.
examples.english: The court sentenced the criminal to death.

examples.hanzi: 有些国家已经取消了死刑。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā yǐjīng qǔxiāo le sǐxíng.
examples.english: Some countries have already abolished the death penalty.

examples.hanzi: 他的成绩比上学期进步了很多。
examples.pinyin: Tā de chéngjì bǐ shàng xuéqī jìnbù le hěn duō.
examples.english: His grades improved a lot compared with last semester.

examples.hanzi: 科学技术的进步改变了我们的生活。
examples.pinyin: Kēxué jìshù de jìnbù gǎibiàn le wǒmen de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Advances in science and technology have changed our lives.

examples.hanzi: 很多年轻人在追求自由的生活。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng rén zài zhuīqiú zìyóu de shēnghuó.
examples.english: Many young people are pursuing a free lifestyle.

examples.hanzi: 他追求了她三年，她才答应。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhuīqiú le tā sān nián, tā cái dāying.
examples.english: He pursued her for three years before she said yes.

examples.hanzi: 爱尔兰的草地一年四季都是绿的。
examples.pinyin: Ài'ěrlán de cǎodì yì nián sìjì dōu shì lǜ de.
examples.english: Ireland's grass is green all year round.

examples.hanzi: 我去爱尔兰旅游的时候，吃了很多土豆。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù Ài'ěrlán lǚyóu de shíhou, chī le hěn duō tǔdòu.
examples.english: When I traveled to Ireland, I ate a lot of potatoes.

examples.hanzi: 亨利每天晚上都在练习中文。
examples.pinyin: Hēnglì měi tiān wǎnshang dōu zài liànxí Zhōngwén.
examples.english: Henry practices Chinese every evening.

examples.hanzi: 你见过亨利的妹妹吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiàn guo Hēnglì de mèimei ma?
examples.english: Have you met Henry's younger sister?

examples.hanzi: 我想买两斤苹果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng jīn píngguǒ.
examples.english: I'd like to buy two jin of apples.

examples.hanzi: 苹果树上结满了红红的苹果。
examples.pinyin: Píngguǒ shù shang jiē mǎn le hónghóng de píngguǒ.
examples.english: The apple tree is full of red apples.

examples.hanzi: 南方的冬天不太冷。
examples.pinyin: Nánfāng de dōngtiān bú tài lěng.
examples.english: Winters in the south are not very cold.

examples.hanzi: 他是南方人，喜欢吃米饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì nánfāng rén, xǐhuan chī mǐfàn.
examples.english: He is from the south and likes eating rice.

examples.hanzi: 这个孩子天生就爱唱歌。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi tiānshēng jiù ài chàng gē.
examples.english: This child loves singing by nature.

examples.pinyin: Tā tiānshēng cōngmíng, xué shénme dōu hěn kuài.
examples.english: He is naturally smart and learns everything fast.

examples.hanzi: 我可不是傻子，这种话我才不信。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kě bú shì shǎzi, zhè zhǒng huà wǒ cái bú xìn.
examples.english: I'm no fool; I won't believe that kind of talk.

examples.hanzi: 他假装做傻子，其实什么都明白。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎzhuāng zuò shǎzi, qíshí shénme dōu míngbai.
examples.english: He pretends to be a fool, but actually understands everything.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhèngzài yùshì lǐ xǐzǎo.
examples.english: I'm taking a bath in the bathroom.

examples.hanzi: 浴室的地板很滑，要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yùshì de dìbǎn hěn huá, yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: The bathroom floor is slippery, so be careful.

examples.hanzi: 他准备了戒指，打算向她求婚。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǔnbèi le jièzhi, dǎsuàn xiàng tā qiúhūn.
examples.english: He prepared a ring and plans to propose to her.

examples.hanzi: 她答应了他的求婚。
examples.pinyin: Tā dāying le tā de qiúhūn.
examples.english: She accepted his marriage proposal.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个关于英雄的传奇故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge guānyú yīngxióng de chuánqí gùshi.
examples.english: This is a legendary story about a hero.

examples.hanzi: 这位老人的经历很传奇。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi lǎorén de jīnglì hěn chuánqí.
examples.english: This old man's life story is quite legendary.

examples.hanzi: 总统明天将会见来访的客人。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng míngtiān jiāng huìjiàn lái fǎng de kèrén.
examples.english: The president will meet visiting guests tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Jìzhě huìjiàn le huòjiǎng de kēxuéjiā.
examples.english: The reporter met with the award-winning scientist.

examples.hanzi: 从家到学校，走路要二十分钟。
examples.pinyin: Cóng jiā dào xuéxiào, zǒulù yào èrshí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: From home to school, it takes twenty minutes on foot.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎo bǎobao yǐjīng huì zǒulù le.
examples.english: The baby can already walk.

examples.hanzi: 他手中拿着一本旧书。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒuzhōng ná zhe yì běn jiù shū.
examples.english: He held an old book in his hand.

examples.hanzi: 这笔钱现在不在我手中。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bǐ qián xiànzài bú zài wǒ shǒuzhōng.
examples.english: I don't have this money on me right now.

examples.hanzi: 看到他那么高兴，可以想见比赛赢得多不容易。
examples.pinyin: Kàndào tā nàme gāoxìng, kěyǐ xiǎngjiàn bǐsài yíng de duō bù róngyì.
examples.english: Seeing how happy he was, you can imagine how hard the game was to win.

examples.hanzi: 从这封信里，可以想见他当时的心情。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhè fēng xìn lǐ, kěyǐ xiǎngjiàn tā dāngshí de xīnqíng.
examples.english: From this letter, you can imagine how he felt at the time.

examples.hanzi: 伊拉克的夏天非常热。
examples.pinyin: Yīlākè de xiàtiān fēicháng rè.
examples.english: Summers in Iraq are extremely hot.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家曾经在伊拉克住过两年。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā céngjīng zài Yīlākè zhù guo liǎng nián.
examples.english: This writer once lived in Iraq for two years.

examples.hanzi: 他的咳嗽不止一天了，应该去看医生。

examples.english: His cough has lasted more than a day; he should see a doctor.

examples.english: He laughed so much that his stomach hurt.

examples.pinyin: Gōngsī qǐng tā dāng jìshù gùwèn.
examples.english: The company asked him to be a technical consultant.

examples.english: We need a legal adviser to help.

examples.english: Being shy is a hindrance to his making friends.

examples.english: There is an obstacle on the road and the car can't get through.

examples.english: In the face of the crisis, he stayed calm.

examples.english: He is very sensitive to what others say about him.

examples.english: This museum has many ancient artifacts.

examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn xīngqīyī bù kāimén.
examples.english: The museum is closed on Mondays.

examples.english: Are you free on Friday? Let's have a meal together.

examples.english: The video camera is pointed at the center of the stage.

examples.english: The employees under this manager all work hard.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ shǒuxià xiànzài méiyǒu nàme duō qián.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng liǎojiě Zhōngguó de yǐnshí wénhuà.
examples.english: I want to learn about Chinese food culture.

examples.english: We must abide by the law.

examples.pinyin: Yǔhángyuán chéngzuò fēichuán huí dào le dìqiú.
examples.english: The astronauts returned to Earth aboard a spacecraft.

examples.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng lǐ yǒu yì sōu hěn dà de fēichuán.
examples.english: This movie features a very large spaceship.

examples.pinyin: Yéye de xiǎngfǎ bǐjiào bǎoshǒu.
examples.english: Grandpa's way of thinking is rather conservative.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng tì wǒ bǎoshǒu zhège mìmì.
examples.english: Please keep this secret for me.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào wéichí liánghǎo de shēntǐ zhuàngtài.
examples.english: We need to maintain a good physical condition.

examples.pinyin: Tā de gōngzī zhǐ néng wéichí yì jiā rén de shēnghuó.
examples.english: His salary can only support his family's living.

examples.hanzi: 请联系销售主管，他会给你答复。

examples.english: The head of this department is on a business trip tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 这是一个资本主义国家。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì yí ge zīběn zhǔyì guójiā.
examples.english: This is a capitalist country.

examples.hanzi: 她是一个乐观主义者。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge lèguān zhǔyìzhě.
examples.english: She is an optimist.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhōumò chángcháng qù pá shān.
examples.english: We often go hiking on the weekends.

examples.pinyin: Tā chángcháng wàngjì dài yàoshi.
examples.english: He often forgets to bring his keys.

examples.english: This photographer often travels around the world taking photos.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge xiǎng dāng yì míng shèyǐngshī.
examples.english: My older brother wants to be a photographer.

examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān, háizimen qù shān lǐ de yíngdì cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: In summer, the kids go to a camp in the mountains for activities.

examples.pinyin: Jūnduì zài hé biān jiànlì le yí ge línshí yíngdì.
examples.english: The army set up a temporary camp by the river.

examples.pinyin: Zhège zérèn wǒ yuànyì chéngdān.
examples.english: I'm willing to take on this responsibility.

examples.hanzi: 他承担了这次活动的所有费用。
examples.pinyin: Tā chéngdān le zhè cì huódòng de suǒyǒu fèiyòng.
examples.english: He covered all the costs of this event.

examples.pinyin: Zhǐhuīguān zhèngzài chákàn dìtú.
examples.english: The commander is looking at the map.

examples.hanzi: 飞行员接到了指挥官的命令。
examples.pinyin: Fēixíngyuán jiēdào le zhǐhuīguān de mìnglìng.
examples.english: The pilot received the commander's order.

examples.hanzi: 我们在酒店大厅等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài jiǔdiàn dàtīng děng nǐ.
examples.english: We'll wait for you in the hotel lobby.

examples.hanzi: 会议在二楼的大厅举行。
examples.pinyin: Huìyì zài èr lóu de dàtīng jǔxíng.
examples.english: The meeting is held in the hall on the second floor.

examples.english: There was an accident at the intersection last night, and traffic is still jammed.

examples.pinyin: Kuài dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, wǒ pà tā chūshì le.
examples.english: Call him quickly; I'm afraid something happened to him.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang xiān dǎsǎo chúfáng.
examples.english: Every morning I clean the kitchen first.

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ yuànzi lǐ de luòyè dǎsǎo yíxià.
examples.english: Please sweep up the fallen leaves in the yard.
